CVE-2026-90778.title: SIPp through 3.7.7 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in ge ...
CVE-2026-90778.description: SIPp through 3.7.7 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in get_peer_tag() function when processing SIP To headers with tag parameters of 2049 bytes or more. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send crafted SIP messages with oversized tag parameters to overflow the static buffer and crash the process.

CVE-2026-90779.title: SIPp through 3.7.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability ...
CVE-2026-90779.description: SIPp through 3.7.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in createAuthHeader() when processing SIP authentication challenges with oversized algorithm parameters. A malicious SIP server can send a crafted 401 or 407 challenge to corrupt the stack and crash the client process.
